name: SlateDB Embedded Object-Storage Database
free_limit: Apache-2.0 embedded Rust LSM key-value database with language bindings; free library without vendor-imposed software request, seat or instance quotas.
watch_out: Not a free hosted database. You must supply S3, R2, GCS or compatible object storage and pay any storage, API request, egress and compute charges. API compatibility may change between versions; production operations are your responsibility.
